The answer is **A) Blend in with**.

"Stand out from" means to be noticeably different or distinctive from others. The antonym (opposite) would be "blend in with," which means to be similar to or inconspicuous among others.

The other options are actually synonyms or similar in meaning to "stand out from":
- B) Distinguish from - means to show differences (similar meaning)
- C) Emerge from - means to come out or become visible (similar meaning)
- D) Separate from - means to set apart (similar meaning)
